name: Fares Allowance
summary: Reimburses travel between your permanent home and campus if you get Youth Allowance or Austudy and have to live away from home.
who: Tertiary students getting Youth Allowance or Austudy who need to live away from home to study.
numbers: One trip to start the academic year and one home at the end
One return trip home during the year if you study 3 months or more of the year
The cheapest practical fare. If you can get a concession fare, only that is paid.
how: It is paid as a lump sum with your Youth Allowance or Austudy. Ask Services Australia how to claim each trip.
catches: Flights are covered only if a train trip would take more than 36 hours, or no car or other public transport is possible.
A flight is reimbursed only if you actually flew.
